text: I'm so sorry to message this late, I know you must be really busy and this probably isn't urgent at all. I'm a foster carer and I've had little Jayden for a few weeks now, he's 3 months old. He's come out in chickenpox spots, they started yesterday, and they're clearly really itchy because he keeps rubbing his face on my shoulder and wriggling. Apart from that he honestly seems himself, smiling at me, feeding like normal, having his naps. He was sick once this evening after his feed, a proper bit of sick not just a dribble, which is what made me worry, but he's had milk twice since and kept both down completely fine. I suppose I just don't know what's normal for chickenpox in a baby this small and with him being in care I feel like I have to double check everything and write it all down. I don't want to waste anyone's time. Is there anything I should be doing or watching for, or is it ok to just keep him comfy and see the GP in the morning? Thank you, and sorry again.
